metadata.purpose: Separates FP-synt from G2 and FG2. Beklemishev-Shamkanov type: FP exists, formalized G2 fails.
metadata.theorem: exists p(p=boxtimes p) does NOT imply FG2
metadata.long_description: G2=F FG2=F FP=T. Primitive boxtimes-fixed point without G2 or FG2. This is the Beklemishev-Shamkanov style separation: a model witnessing exists p. p=boxtimes(p) that does not force G2 or FG2. The element c is the syntactic FP.
